findings.text: follow-on: the done_when requires the test files importing the three readers' modules to show no added failure against base, but only a focused 10/11-file gate ran against the manifest's own 217-file importer population, so the whole-population half of the measure is unmeasured; the manifest names this and defers it to a merge-verification node.

follow-on: the fragment states "a cold roadmap read builds each plan file's soup 3 times at base and 1 time here; a cold discovery read builds it 2 times at base and 1 time here" as measurements, but the run kept no log of the base arm's count — gate_base.log ran the 10-file focused gate with the count test excluded — so the base halves are a scratch-probe figure not recheckable from any artefact the run stored.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against f43062fc8; 92b46705c changes three functions in two source files and adds the test, 08c6cb0a9 adds the 21-line evidence fragment, and no other file changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the source done_when names tests/test_a_cold_read_parses_each_plan_once.py counting one soup per plan file on a cold roadmap read (:143) and a cold discovery read (:156) with the three readers' outputs equal to a direct parse and no added failure over the importing test files; the manifest records head 189 passed / base 186 passed, both exit 0, and the negative control red, but the importing-files element is measured on a 10/11-file subset of the 217-file importer population (manifest follow_ons), so that half of the done_when is not fully measured.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that within one read each plan file's soup is built once and shared by read_state_and_text_file, parse_plan and project state's _cached_plan_state through the file memo; reckon/_plan_html.py:1403 routes read_state_file through read_state_and_text_file, :2342 routes _parse_plan_uncached through it, and reckon/project_state.py:1185 routes _cached_plan_state through it, so all three derive from one parse.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it declares status complete, records the base f43062fc8 and head 92b46705c commits plus the 08c6cb0a9 fragment, the base 186 / head 189 passed gate figures, the reader set, the negative_control_log path and its mutation, and names the importer-population shortfall under follow_ons.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source FENCE-SCOPE names reckon/_plan_html.py, reckon/project_state.py, reckon/file_memo.py, reckon/_store.py, tests/test_a_cold_read_parses_each_plan_once.py, the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline/a-cold-read-parses-each-plan-once.html and the figures dir; every path in the diff (reckon/_plan_html.py, reckon/project_state.py, tests/test_a_cold_read_parses_each_plan_once.py, the fragment) is inside that set, and file_memo.py and _store.py were permitted but not needed.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_cold_read_parses_each_plan_once.py:151 and :164 assert an independently counted soup count equals the literal 1 and fail at 2 under the declared mutation, as negative_control.log records (2 failed), so they redden if any reader re-forks its own parse.
justifications.evidence: gate_head.log ends "189 passed ... EXIT=0" at rev 92b46705c and negative_control.log ends "2 failed, 1 passed ... EXIT=1", both recorded, but the done_when's "importing test files show no added failure" is measured only on a 10/11-file subset of the manifest's 217-file importer population.
justifications.fit: the change adds no symbol and only mechanism comments at reckon/_plan_html.py:1401-1402 and :2341 and reckon/project_state.py:1184, following the module's existing memo idiom with no forbidden label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_plan_html.py:1403 and :2342 and reckon/project_state.py:1185 all call read_state_and_text_file, so a cold read builds each plan file's soup once and the three readers share it.
justifications.reuse: no definition is added; each reader is routed onto read_state_and_text_file, the existing owner of the shared plan parse in reckon/_plan_html.py, and a repository search for a prior shared-parse owner found none other.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only reckon/_plan_html.py, reckon/project_state.py, tests/test_a_cold_read_parses_each_plan_once.py and the fragment, all inside the declared write paths, and adds nothing the goal does not imply.
